page.title: Card step for Long match box

product.name: Long match box
product.description: The matches are long and packed in a slide box.

blocks.text: The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Long match box matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
Sales tax is collected where the state requires it.
You are paying Trailmeter at www.trailmeter.example.
